SELECT e.no AS enrollment_no, e.member_id AS member_id, e.exam_no AS exam_no, e.theme AS theme, NVL(e.totalscore, 0) AS total_score, e.status AS status, TO_CHAR(e.starttime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS start_time, TO_CHAR(e.endtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS end_time, ROUND((CAST(e.endtime AS DATE)-CAST(e.starttime AS DATE))*24*60*60) AS spent_seconds, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer WHERE enrollment_no=e.no) AS total_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no=q.no WHERE a.enrollment_no=e.no AND q.type NOT IN (1)) AS subjective_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_user_answer a JOIN exam_question q ON a.question_no=q.no WHERE a.enrollment_no=e.no AND q.type NOT IN (1) AND a.is_correct!='W') AS subjective_graded FROM exam_enrollment e WHERE e.no=#{enrollmentNo} AND e.member_id=#{memberId}

SELECT a.no AS answer_no, a.question_no AS question_no, a.user_answer AS user_answer, a.is_correct AS is_correct, NVL(a.score, 0) AS score, q.title AS title, q.image AS image, o.option1 AS option1, o.option2 AS option2, o.option3 AS option3, o.option4 AS option4, CASE WHEN e.status='COMPLETE' OR q.type=1 THEN q.answer END AS standard_answer, CASE WHEN e.status='COMPLETE' OR q.type=1 THEN TO_CHAR(q.description) END AS description, q.type AS question_type, q.score AS max_score FROM EXAM_USER_ANSWER a JOIN EXAM_QUESTION q ON a.question_no=q.no JOIN EXAM_ENROLLMENT e ON a.enrollment_no=e.no LEFT JOIN EXAM_OPTION o ON q.no=o.question_no WHERE a.enrollment_no = #{enrollmentNo} ORDER BY a.question_no ASC

SELECT e.no AS enrollment_no, e.exam_no AS exam_no, e.theme AS theme, e.totalscore AS total_score, e.status AS status, TO_CHAR(e.starttime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS start_time, TO_CHAR(e.endtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS end_time, CASE WHEN e.exam_no IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT title FROM scheduled_exam WHERE no = e.exam_no) ELSE '상시 모의고사' END AS exam_title FROM exam_enrollment e WHERE e.member_id = #{memberId} AND e.endtime IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.no DESC
